This is a minimal example of a data wrangling file.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)

set.seed(123)
```


```{r}
#| label: sim-data-plot
n <- 100

dat <- tibble(
  participant = rep(1:20, each = n / 20),
  condition = rep(c("congruent", "incongruent"), times = n / 2),
  rt = rnorm(n, mean = ifelse(condition == "congruent", 500, 550), sd = 50)
)

# Summary
dat |>
  summarise(
    mean_rt = mean(rt),
    sd_rt = sd(rt),
    .by = condition
  )

# Plot
dat |>
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = rt, fill = condition)) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Simulated RT by condition",
    x = "Condition",
    y = "Reaction time (ms)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(
  "dat_plot.png",
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)

write_csv(
  dat,
  "data.csv"
)
```
